title: SRC is the largest Slovenian-owned integrator and covers both banking and public sector
content:
SRC is recorded as the largest Slovenian-owned integrator, working both banking and public sector, at around 300 staff. Domestic ownership is the part worth noting: in a market where many large integrators are subsidiaries of foreign groups, a domestically owned firm sets its own technology direction rather than inheriting one.

It also covers both verticals the lead set targets, which is unusual at that size. What is absent is everything technical — the stack was not researched and no open-source posture was established — so the lead is qualified on ownership, scale and sector coverage alone. Priority 3.
